title: Samsung aims to be a one-stop shop that builds, runs, and powers AI data centers; sources: its IT arm is in early talks to sign Anthropic and OpenAI as tenants (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Samsung aims to be a one-stop shop that builds, runs, and powers AI data centers; sources: its IT arm is in early talks to sign Anthropic and OpenAI as tenants — South Korean conglomerate hopes to replicate success with semiconductors across its sprawling portfolio of businesses
